integrity: All formulas follow from the explicitly specified conditional Bernoulli transition mechanism; an exact finite transition enumerator supports the analytic proof but does not replace it.
scientific_limitations: Finite populations divisible by three; independent reactivated per-agent opposition and fresh uniform partitions; only two exact parameter corners; precise survival exponent rather than full law. Earlier deterministic identity-map results are acknowledged and not claimed new.
title: Exact finite-population consensus decay at two neutral contrarian corners
